phase: P1 third increment: immutable shared capital adapters
implemented: Schema-aware capital reader validates immutable intent/config/plan identity without synthesizing legacy strategy fields; HELD reads are batch SQL without per-episode query round-trips.

New plan explicitly freezes roundtrip costs and adverse-price envelope; risk is the conservative maximum of declared loss, original buffered loss, current fixed-stop loss plus costs, and original reservation.
New opening requires account policy, capital and portfolio-risk budgets even with finite legacy limits; enabled capital pool cannot exceed 70 percent.
Mixed old/new HELD risk shares one account budget. New reservations require exact plan digest and positive original margin/risk floors. Partial exits and UNKNOWN do not release risk.
Pending margin counts unfilled/partial/ambiguous siblings conservatively, distinguishes venue-covered complete fills from snapshot overlap, and exposes overlap/partial/incomplete counters.
Both exchange occurrence and local durable-fill timestamps guard against treating a late-recorded fill as included in an earlier inventory snapshot.
New schema initially supports one full-quantity OPEN only; partial fills remain manageable but further opening allocation is explicitly denied.
Pre-POST checks full quantity, leverage, account scope and immutable original reservation. Changes requiring larger risk/margin deny rather than silently enlarging a reservation.
Optional normalized leverage evidence is strictly validated even for low leverage; maintenance checks use retained risk at current entry, not only the initial stop fraction.
Exact intermediate notional can exceed 18 decimal places; final risk/margin ceilings preserve the money boundary without rounding source facts.

qa.boundary: Dedicated disposable PostgreSQL/Redis; V2 conftest blocks external TCP. No running service database or real exchange calls.

intermediate_runs.note: Initial affected legacy/core regression before the final proof refinements.
Caught missing normalized leverage fields and high-scale derived notional rejection; remaining failures were incomplete new fixtures. Fixed source validation and fixtures.
New historical fixtures omitted episode foreign keys and cancellation fill-reconciliation evidence; corrected fixtures without relaxing production guards.
Remaining partial-allocation test omitted the existing mandatory decision reason; corrected the fixture.

qa.scope: Capital increment and affected new/legacy execution regression, not whole repository, real exchange lifecycle, or profitability acceptance.

independent_review: Third read-only review found no remaining P1/P2 blockers for this capital increment; activation limitations are explicitly retained.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; no new claim of exchange inventory verification.

remaining_before_activation: New plan actual venue authorization, native protection, frozen software exits, cash verification, settlement and analytics are not yet fully connected.
Versioned management scheduling and upstream opportunity/terminal consumption handling remain unfinished.
No exact partial-allocation adapter or atomic reservation top-up; partial/snapshot-overlap margin may conservatively overlap venue margin and reduce capacity.
Verified compounding/recovery still recognizes directional-settlement-v1 only; new settlement provenance must be explicitly adapted before recognition.
No restored trading, research window start or new strategy activation based on this increment.
profitability_claim: None. Engineering safety/compatibility tests do not establish strategy edge or live execution quality.
